en: Black-and-white postcard showing a large, three-story, white neoclassical building with a dark roof, fronted by trees and an open cobblestone or gravel square. A tall flagpole and a small monument or marker stand in the square. The viewpoint is low, near the ground, emphasizing the texture of the square. Printed caption text appears in the lower-left corner, and a small oval printer's mark appears in the lower-right corner.
